name: proto-ts-proto-output-schema-without-decoders
description: ts-proto output written with outputSchema but without what joins a field to its descriptor, a message's references entry under outputEncodeMethods=false, a decode under outputEncodeMethods=encode-only, or the file descriptor under outputSchema=no-file-descriptor, is output of the option set that writes no service path: each file is one fallback of scope all, published live, the run succeeds, and no message is a consumer.
